prior_context: Existing pruned comparisons are contextual independent stochastic realizations, not a matched run for this exact scope-only patch.
outcome: Completed exactly two ordinary snapshots. Multi-second gaps and upload drain remain; this is not fluent-performance acceptance or an isolated causal speed effect of the late-startup scope correction.

raw_archive.contents: Each of the two raw case directories contributes exact client.log,server.log,probe.json,probe.err,service.jsonl; archive preserves full socket and unprojected service evidence.

limitations: Independent stochastic loss/jitter realizations: prior pruned measurements are context, not a matched isolated patch A/B or universal ranking.
Download includes one actual timed-out echo attempt; subsequent unavailable slots are unattempted after connection failure, not independent network failures.
Upload probes target-confirmed delivery; the exact average includes all59.293229s of settlement. Its interval series timestamps confirmation arrival at client, not target write or wire arrival.
The85s runner completion guard was not reached by either cell; no tail is censored.
Application/confirmation catch-up can exceed500Mbps in a one-second bin without proving physical-link overspeed; bins are retained without clipping.
The existing probes provide greatest gap metrics and one-second bins, not every exact read or confirmation timestamp/per-phase maximum gap.
Sampled ps CPU is process lifetime average and RSS includes allocator footprint; neither alone proves current CPU saturation or a memory leak.
Management may omit unavailable values; these are preserved as null rather than synthesized zero. Qdisc hierarchy counters may overlap; do not sum duplicated counters.
No native or Product diagnostic event flags are enabled. Absence of the former late-startup warning does not measure how often the clean refusal branch was executed.
